::: {#def-npsem-ne .theorem}
## NPSEM-GE

A non-parametric structural equation model with grouped errors (NPSEM-GE) is an NPSEM that includes two kinds of structural equations: those that describe the causal process as it unfolds within units (structural), and those that describe the causal process as it unfolds across units (relational). In the former type, error terms are mutually independent. In the latter, error terms are dependent within groups of equations defined as graph generators. 


:::
